status: owner-approved 2026-07-13; enterprise-policy scenarios remain qualification work

operating_system: Windows 11 x64 on a Microsoft-supported build
filesystem: local NTFS application and data paths
supported.container_runtime: App-managed rootless Podman Machine using WSL2
supported.user_model: One Windows owner per application data profile
gateway_profiles: qualified private Windows gateway after Phase 8
supported.elevation: Installation and runtime provisioning only; routine operation is standard-user

qualification_required: Antivirus and EDR exclusions or compatibility
Non-English locale and timezone or clock changes
Sleep, hibernate, logoff, shutdown, concurrent launch, and multiple users
Private gateway TLS, listener, client identity, and firewall profiles
